documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited reported a strong start to FY 27 with Q1 revenue growing 33% year-on-year to INR 1,364 crore and EBITDA up 51% to INR 205 crore, driven by robust performance across divisions like Advanced Plastics and Mechatronics. Management highlighted a healthy order book of INR 1,600 crore and ongoing expansion projects, including a new plant at Chakan, a mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, and a new Greenfuel facility in Nashik. While remaining watchful of macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation, and supply chain dynamics, the company maintains its long-term '20.20.20.20 Vision' targeting a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031. Full-year capex is guided around INR 300 crore, to be primarily funded through internal accruals. Lumax Auto Technologies Limited released its investor presentation for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting a consolidated revenue of INR 1,364 crores and an EBITDA of INR 205 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects the effective tax rate to remain around 25% going forward.
guidance.quote: The effective tax rate continues to remain at around 25%, which is also expected to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: Full-year capex guidance continues to remain around INR 300 crore.
guidance.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

guidance.claim: Management stated confidence in sustaining the current Q1 margins for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: On the margin front, I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its long-term 20% revenue CAGR vision from 2025 to 2031.
guidance.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

guidance.claim: The Mechatronics division is anticipated to reach close to INR 1,000 crore top line by FY 2030-31.
guidance.quote: I think, to me, by FY 2030-31, we should definitely be looking at close to INR 1,000 crore top line from Mechatronics division.

guidance.claim: The company targets a minimum revenue CAGR of 20% organic plus inorganic under its mid-term plan.
Management has a vision for an EBITDA margin of 20% under the strategy.
Management targets 20% plus contribution from future and clean mobility.
The company expects to continue outperforming industry growth in FY 27.
guidance.quote: Hence, my direction and guidance for the year would be that the Company is pretty confident that we will continue to outperform the industry growth.

guidance.claim: Management targets maintaining a mid-term CAGR strategy of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

guidance.claim: For the full year, margins should sustain or further go up by at least 30 bps or so.
guidance.quote: So for the full year, I do not foresee any reason that the margins would get negatively impacted. On the contrary, I would say, on account of the top line growth, the margin should just sustain or at least further go up by at least 30 bps or so.

guidance.claim: The effective tax rate for FY 26 is 26%, and the company expects it to hold at similar levels going forward.
guidance.quote: Excluding the same, the effective tax rate for FY 26 comes out as 26%, and we expect it to hold at similar levels way forward.

guidance.claim: The minority share for FY 26 is at 17%, which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.
guidance.quote: The minority share for FY 26, however, is at 17%, and which is expected to be in a similar range going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Indian automotive production witnessed a healthy growth of 22% year-on-year in Q1 FY 27.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the challenging operating environment, the Indian automotive industry has delivered a strong start to FY 27, with production witnessing a healthy growth of 22% year-on-year (y-o-y), with all major vehicle segments reporting good traction.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer demand was supported by lower GST rates, easier financing, new model launches, and improved monsoon conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: The broad-based growth in production was led by lower GST rates, easier financing, new model launches, leading to resilient consumer demand. In Q1 FY 27, passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and 3-wheelers recorded their highest-ever 1st Quarter sales, while exports across all vehicle segments also reached record levels. Improved monsoon conditions and stable inflation further supported demand, particularly in the rural markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects demand to remain healthy as the festive season approaches and OEM inventory levels remain low.
demand_outlook.quote: As we enter the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy, with many leading OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) reporting low inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favorable for FY 27.
demand_outlook.quote: In closing, while we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favourable, giving us confidence as we enter FY 27.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum of demand continues to be present for the current Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: However, of course, there are certain input costs and margin pressures. But the demand from a retail point of view, still seems to be intact.

demand_outlook.claim: CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So CNG continues to have a very strong pull in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Rural demand showed gradual improvement aided by better agricultural output and government spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Rural demand also showed gradual improvement aided by better agricultural output and government spending which positively impacted entry level vehicle demand and 2-wheeler volumes.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant at Chakan is being set up for the IAC division to cater to Mahindra & Mahindra demand.
capex_expansion.quote: • A new plant at Chakan for the IAC division to cater to upcoming demand from Mahindra & Mahindra, while simultaneously optimizing product lines between this facility and the existing ones.

capex_expansion.claim: The Manesar mega Mechatronics plant is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: • The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility is being set up in Nashik to cater to Greenfuel Energy's requirements for Mahindra.
capex_expansion.quote: • At Greenfuel Energy, we are pleased to report that we onboarded Mahindra as a new customer and to cater to their requirements, we shall be setting up a new facility in Nashik.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex during the first quarter stood at INR 23 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the 1st Quarter was INR 23 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 23 crores.
Total capex during the year was INR 233 crore, including strategic investments in land and capacity expansions.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex during the year was INR 233 crore, which included strategic investment in land in Gujarat and Kharkhoda Region of INR 45 crore and also almost INR 100 crore on capacity expansions in IAC and Lumax Alps Alpine.

capex_expansion.claim: Projected capex for the year is between INR 275 crore to INR 300 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: So again, capacity, I would say, is pretty much in line with the OEM growth plan, and it is reflected in our capex plans for the year, which Ankit had mentioned, it would be anywhere between INR 275 crore to INR 300 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for FY 26 stood at INR 705 crore with a margin of 14.5%.
margins_costs.quote: The Company also crossed the INR 700 crore mark for EBITDA to reach record EBITDA of INR 705 crore with a healthy margin of 14.5% along with a record PAT of INR 337 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Inflationary cost increases face a lag of 3 to 6 months before realizations are received from OEMs.
margins_costs.quote: It is just a lag of about 3 to 6 months depending on the OEM by when we get these realizations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 24% of the order book is expected to be executed in FY 27, 56% in FY 28, and 20% in FY 29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

orders_capacity.claim: The Advanced Plastics division order book stands at INR 787 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book remains strong at INR 787 crore for this division, providing solid future visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book progresses in stages achieving full completion by FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book is set to progress in stages achieving full completion by FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 28 manufacturing plants across pan-India.
Advanced plastics contributed the largest share of the order book, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels, and Structures & Control Systems.
orders_capacity.quote: The order book continues to reflect a healthy traction across all our product verticals with advanced plastics contributing the largest share, followed by Mechatronics, alternate fuels and Structures & Control Systems.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the total order book, approximately 25% is expected to be executed in FY 27, 54% in FY 28, and 21% in FY 29.
orders_capacity.quote: Of this order book, approximately 25% is expected to be executed in this financial year FY 27, 54% in FY 28 and the remaining 21% in FY 29.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we continue to maintain a strong balance sheet and a healthy liquidity position. Free cash reserves stood at INR 415 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32.
capital_allocation.quote: The long-term debt stood at INR 508 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.32, which is within our internal comfort thresholds.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash reserves stood at INR 396 crore, providing us with the financial flexibility to support ongoing investments and navigate market cycles confidently.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term debt stood at INR 553 crore, resulting in a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.46.
capital_allocation.quote: The long-term debt stood at INR 553 crore, resulting in a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.46, which is within our internal comfort thresholds.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains an internal dividend payout policy of a minimum 35% payout ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: So the payout ratio, we have a very fair internal policy of maintaining a minimum 35% payout ratio and the Company continues to maintain that for the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted global challenges including the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, energy security concerns, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economy continues to navigate a challenging geopolitical landscape with the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, heightening concerns around energy security, supply chain disruptions, and inflationary pressures.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments, and supply chain dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, geopolitical developments and supply chain dynamics that could influence input costs and overall market sentiment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted short-term pressure on margins due to raw material commodities, manpower costs, and energy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: So Amit, most of the inflationary costs, be it on account of raw material commodities or also the manpower cost, which has significantly risen up due to certain minimum wage hikes, also the energy price is going up, all of it has, of course, put some short-term pressure on the margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: Labor shortages were experienced during the year due to elections or war-related scenarios.
risks_headwinds.quote: So yes, it is very much a fact and there is no point saying that there are no labour shortages that we have experienced either due to elections or due to the war-related scenario or other conditions.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031.
management_commitments.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aspires to double its current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore by FY 2031.
management_commitments.quote: And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: The Mechatronics plant in Manesar is scheduled to be commissioned by Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: The previously announced mega Mechatronics plant in Manesar, Haryana is expected to be commissioned by Q3 of this year, where we are consolidating four entities, Lumax Yokowo, Lumax Alps Alpine, Lumax Ituran and Lumax FAE, under one roof to optimize resources and fixed costs.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a minimum 20% revenue CAGR through organic and inorganic streams by FY31.
Management targets an EBITDA margin of 20% by FY31.
Management plans to achieve net zero carbon emissions across operations by FY28.
The company expects to execute approximately 25% of the INR 1,450 crore order book in FY 27.
management_commitments.quote: Of this order book, approximately 25% is expected to be executed in this financial year FY 27, 54% in FY 28 and the remaining 21% in FY 29.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets maintaining a mid-term CAGR strategy of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, I think we continue to be on par with the mid-term strategy of our 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Full repayment of the acquisition-related debt starts from FY 27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And out of this INR 1,000 crore, almost long-term debt is contributing around from INR 550 crore to INR 570-odd crore, and balance is of short-term debt. And long-term debt of INR 550-odd crore. And I think more than 90% of it has been taken by the Company on account of the 2 and 3 inorganic acquisitions, which the Company has done in the last 2 to 3 years. And accordingly, their repayment or I would say, the full repayment is starting from this year onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Lumax Ituran's FY 27 guidance remains in place for up to 150 basis points improvement in EBITDA margins internally projected right now.
management_commitments.quote: However, the FY 27 guidance remains in place for up to 150 basis points improvement as is being projected internally right now.

management_commitments.claim: The total transition of automatic gear shifters to shift-by-wire would take another about 36 months to become 50-50.
management_commitments.quote: However, the total transition would take another about 36 months when it would become 50-50.

management_commitments.claim: New Body Control Modules (BCM) are getting into start of production (SOP) in 45 to 60 days.
management_commitments.quote: It is already supporting our upcoming new product, Body Control Modules (BCM) that are getting into SOP in 45 to 60 days from now, it is driving the software integration for that.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
